name: Mindgard
what_it_does: Automated AI red-teaming platform from a UK-academic-rooted vendor. Strong on attack libraries derived from current research and on integration into CI for continuous evaluation.
what_it_doesnt_do: Smaller vendor than some commercial peers; weigh vendor risk per your TPRM threshold. Reporting tailored to engineers; pair with internal capability to produce executive narratives.
best_for: Engineering-led AI security functions wanting research-current attack coverage
Teams who want regular re-evaluation in CI rather than annual point-in-time tests
not_for: Buyers needing a wide product surface from a single vendor
